description: Return Divisions results grouped by party

queryParameters.divisionNumber.description: Division Number - as specified by the House, unique within a session. This is different to the division id which uniquely identifies a division in this system and is passed to the GET division endpoint

queryParameters.endDate.description: Divisions where division date in one or before date provided. Date format is yyyy-MM-dd

queryParameters.includeWhenMemberWasTell.description: Divisions where member was a teller as well as if they actually voted

queryParameters.memberId.description: Divisions returning Member with Member ID voting records

queryParameters.searchTerm.description: Divisions containing search term within title or number

queryParameters.startDate.description: Divisions where division date in one or after date provided. Date format is yyyy-MM-dd

name: ukpcv_divisions_grouped_by_party
title: ukpcv_divisions_grouped_by_party
